info.title: AI.Sentinel.Cli
info.description: Offline replay CLI for AI.Sentinel — run the detector pipeline against saved conversations, browse the local audit file with 'sentinel dashboard', and build a compliance report from it with 'sentinel report'. The dashboard command needs the ASP.NET Core runtime, which the .NET SDK includes.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Run the AI.Sentinel detector pipeline against a saved conversation.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Path to a prior ReplayResult JSON for regression comparison.

options.name: --compliance
options.description: Also run the opt-in Art. 5 compliance detectors CMP-01 to CMP-04. SENTINEL_HOOK_COMPLIANCE=on does the same. [default: False]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the conversation file (OpenAI JSON or AI.Sentinel audit NDJSON).

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Browse the local audit file in the AI.Sentinel dashboard.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the audit SQLite file. Defaults to the file the hooks and the MCP proxy write. [default: <path>]

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on (127.0.0.1 only). Use 0 for any free port. [default: 5170]

commands.name: report
commands.description: Build a compliance report from the local audit file.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the audit SQLite file. Defaults to the file the hooks and the MCP proxy write. [default: <path>]

options.name: --from
options.description: Start of the period: an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd, from 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 30 days before --to.

options.name: --to
options.description: End of the period, inclusive: an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd, to the end of that UTC day) or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to now.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: md, html or json. [default: md]

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write the report to. Defaults to standard output.
